A passing '''comet''' once impacted [[Needan]],<ref name="AlienEncounters" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Journal13">{{JournalCite|13|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref> [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] a single [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="AlienEncounters" /> in the [[Death/Legends|dying]]<ref name="Journal5">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref> [[Needan system/Legends|Needan system]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA" /> The collision sent Needan into a wider orbit,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|329|Geelan}}</ref> on a trajectory rapidly carrying it away from its sun.<ref name="AlienEncounters" />

The consequent permanently [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] and [[Winter/Legends|winter]]-like climate led to the extinction of the majority of [[Species/Legends|species]] of the planet, which originally featured immense [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] teeming with living organisms as well as [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] on the land portion of its surface. Needan's [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Geelan]] species survived the disaster by building and retreating to [[Domed city/Legends|dome-like habitats]]. When the Geelan realized, however, that the [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] supply on which their society was relying was rapidly dwindling, the species' [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] began sending out [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signals]] into outer [[Realspace/Legends|space]], leading to a first contact with the wider [[galactic community]]<ref name="AlienEncounters" /> at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="Journal5" /> and the subsequent emigration of many Geelan off their doomed [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="AlienEncounters" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Comet/Legends|comet]] was first mentioned in the "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]" feature of the [[May]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|thirteenth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine. The feature was authored by [[Brian Smithson]].<ref name="Journal13" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Needan [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the comet, in grid square I-20.<ref name="TEA" />
